blocks.title: One phase machine, a model that patches filters, products from the catalog
blocks.text: AssistantPanel sends every tap and submit to one ConversationStore, which runs idle, listening, thinking and speaking. SpeechClient streams the live microphone to the speech service. IntentClient sends the final text with the SearchFilters, the facet values and any choice; the store validates the raw reply into an IntentResult, applies its FilterPatch to the turn draft and searches through CatalogGateway. When the SearchPage lands, the draft commits, ResultsGrid renders it and SpeechClient speaks a summary filled from it.

blocks.title: Worked example: a spoken search and an interruption

steps.title: The shopper asks
steps.text: The shopper taps talk, opening turn t_1; a tone plays once the microphone is live. They say running shoes in size 42 under 120 and tap again.

steps.title: The reply becomes a patch
steps.text: Skeleton cards fill the empty grid. The validated patch sets category running-shoes, size 42 and a maximum price of 120; the store checks the category, fetches its facets and checks the size.

steps.title: The catalog answers
steps.text: The search returns 14 products, so the draft commits: three chips, 14 cards, and a summary filled from the first card, the Trail 3 at 98.

steps.title: The shopper interrupts
steps.text: Halfway through, the shopper taps talk and says in blue. speechSynthesis is cancelled before the microphone opens, and the 14 cards stay.

steps.title: A follow-up edits the filters
steps.text: Turn t_2 returns a patch that sets color to blue. Its search lands with six products, the draft commits, and a fourth chip appears.

blocks.alt: Flow from the panel through the conversation store to the speech, intent and catalog clients, and back to the panel and the results grid.
